method: Built-in imagegen precise local edits, followed by manually authored facial masks. Whole generated face/body is not a runtime texture.

Preserve exact head pose, outline, proportions, eye centers, hair strands, nose, collar, shoulder, badge, star embroidery, painterly rendering, cream backdrop and framing. Keep nose. No sockets, eyelids, blur smears, new features or text. This is the underlying face surface for an animation rig.
